description.zh:
命名空间状态，取值：

- `NORMAL`：正常

- `DELETING`：删除中
description.en:
The status of the namespace. Valid values:

*   `NORMAL`: The namespace is normal.
*   `DELETING`: The namespace is being deleted.
The number of the page to return.
The number of entries to return on each page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr list-chart-namespace --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --namespace-status NORMAL --namespace-name test --page-no 1 --page-size 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr ListChartNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --NamespaceStatus NORMAL --NamespaceName test --PageSize 30 --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --PageNo 1
